versions.changelog:
miremo v1.0.2

- Expanded description and research strategies to support retrieval and use of user-authored method skills, workflows, and output templates.
- Added "Method Skill" tools: list, search, and retrieve reusable Miremo skills by ID or slug.
- Updated skill usage guidance: new Mode D for applying method skill materials, including triggers and workflow.
- Replaced document list/read tools with new collection and document-section outline tools.
- Removed obsolete or redundant documentation files (e.g., skill-card.md).

- Added support for multiple workspaces with new tools: `list_workspaces` and `get_current_workspace`
- All main tools (`search_memos`, `global_search`, `list_memos`, `list_supertags`, `list_documents`, `create_memo`) now accept an optional `workspace_id` to target specific workspaces
- Updated research strategies and workflows to handle workspace context and cross-workspace research
- Improved documentation on workspace-aware behavior and clarified default vs explicit workspace usage
- Minor: Homepage URL updated to https://www.miremoapp.com

Initial release of the Miremo skill for OpenClaw.

- Search and browse your personal Miremo knowledge base, including memos, documents, topic tags (supertags), and knowledge graph.
- Save new notes directly from chat using “create memo.”
- Use structured workflows for topic research, overviews, and exact lookups of your own content.
- Explore your AI-extracted entities and their relationships via the built-in knowledge graph tools.
- Skill responds only to queries about your stored notes, not general internet searches.
